title: Condensation polymerisation: nylon-6,6
caption: A diacid and a diamine join to form an amide link, losing water each time; repeating this at both ends of each monomer builds a polyamide. Unlike addition polymers, condensation polymers have a small molecule as a by-product and can be broken down by hydrolysis.
alt: Hexanedioic acid plus hexane-1,6-diamine gives one amide-linked unit plus water.
description: Hexanedioic acid: a carboxylic acid at each end.
Hexane-1,6-diamine: an amine at each end.
They join through an amide bond, releasing H₂O.
